lines.text: Find setups has 169 building blocks in 18 groups, from price and averages to structure, breakouts and company data.
For example: SMA and EMA, RSI, swings and breaks, candle patterns, and RSI divergence.
Some groups show only when your administrator switches them on, and some are reached only through the Formula block under Advanced.
In a row, tap the function's name to open the list and search it.
Each block starts with a default setting; change it to your own.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Something not working? Read the line beside Run first: it names the reason.
A stock that could not be read gets a reason and one button: Log in, Retry, or Try another timeframe.
Your broker login has ended? Press Log in, then run again.
The broker's request limit was reached? Wait a minute, then press Retry.
Matched 0 of 50 is not an error: no stock met all the conditions. Loosen, or switch off, the one that removes the most.
Different from a live chart? A scan uses closed candles; a live chart also shows the forming one.
The time pill turned amber? The results are older than two candles; press Run again.
Coming soon? It is not switched on for your organisation yet. Ask your administrator.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
That is Find setups: a list, a chart, a scan, a run, and the results.
Conditions on data, for your own study and your own decision.
A match is information, not a signal and not advice. Scans and alerts never place, change or cancel an order.
Keep the written guide beside you: it has every step and every block.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
